function.name: click_element
function.description: Click an element. Auto-scrolls to it first. Use count for repeated clicks (e.g. 'click 3 times').

count.description: Number of times to click (for challenges requiring repeated clicks). Default 1, max 10.

function.name: type_text
function.description: Type into an input field. Auto-focuses and auto-scrolls. Clears existing text in input/textarea fields; appends in contenteditable. Only set pressEnter for single-field forms (search bars). For multi-field forms, fill all fields first then click the submit button.

function.name: scroll_page
function.description: Scroll the page or a container. If you know what text you're looking for, use find_element instead — it scrolls directly to it.

id.description: Container tag ID. Omit for window.

function.name: read_page
function.description: Force a fresh DOM snapshot. Only needed after find_element fails or after dynamic content changes. The page snapshot is already in your context each turn — don't call this just to 'see' the page.

function.name: create_tab
function.description: Open a new tab in this workspace. Returns the new tab's ID. Use switch_tab to make it active for subsequent tools.

function.name: close_tab
function.description: Close a tab in this workspace. Cannot close the current tab — switch_tab to another tab first.

function.name: switch_tab
function.description: Switch to another tab in this workspace. All subsequent tool calls will run on this tab until you switch again.

function.name: wait
function.description: Pause for dynamic content to load, then re-orient. Returns your original goal, plan progress, and fresh page state. Use for timed reveals, animations, or AJAX loads — not just to re-read the page (use read_page for that).

reason.description: Why you're pausing (e.g. 'lost track of which step I'm on').

function.name: done
function.description: Signal task completion or answer the user's question with a summary.

summary.description: What was accomplished, or your answer to the user's question.

function.name: hover_element
function.description: Hover to reveal menus, tooltips, or hidden content. Auto-scrolls to element.

function.name: find_element
function.description: Find exact visible text on the page, scroll to it, and return its tag ID. Only works with text that literally appears on screen — do NOT search for conceptual labels, element types, or attribute values. Use read_page first if unsure what text exists.

function.name: select_option
function.description: Select an option from a native HTML <select> dropdown. For custom dropdowns (div-based menus), click the menu to open it then click the option.

function.name: press_key
function.description: Press a keyboard key on the page (dispatched to window, not a specific element). For typing into fields, use type_text. Useful for Escape, Tab, Enter, arrow keys.

function.name: drag_and_drop
function.description: Drag source element to target element. Look for elements with draggable=true (sources) and dropzone=true (targets) in the page snapshot. Source is auto-scrolled into view but target is NOT — scroll to reveal both elements first if they're far apart.

function.name: hide_element
function.description: Hide an overlay blocking interaction (sets display:none). Must match overlay heuristics: fixed/absolute + z-index>100, dialog role, backdrop-filter, or >30% viewport coverage. If rejected, try click_element on a close button or press_key Escape instead.

function.name: dismiss_overlays
function.description: Aggressively dismiss ALL visible popups, modals, cookie banners, overlays, and dialogs on the page. Fast — no text is captured. Use when overlays block interaction and you don't need their content.

function.name: escalate
function.description: Switch to a smarter, slower model for complex reasoning. Use when stuck on riddles, puzzles, math, or multi-step logic.

reason.description: Why the current model can't handle this.

function.name: read_element
function.description: Read a specific attribute (href, src, value) of an element. For visible text, check the page snapshot first — it's already there.

attribute.description: Attribute to read (e.g. "href", "src", "value"). Omit for text content.

function.name: execute_js
function.description: Run JavaScript in the page context. Use for hidden/computed values, timers, or DOM queries that tagged elements can't reach. Returns the result as a string. IMPORTANT: No jQuery — use el.textContent.includes() not :contains(). Use el.getAttribute('class') not el.className (fails on SVG). Use Array.from(querySelectorAll(...)) for array methods. Wrap in (function(){ ... })() if using return.

function.name: upload_file
function.description: Upload a file to an <input type="file"> element. Downloads the file from the URL (max 10MB), then injects it into the file input.

url.description: URL of the file to upload.

function.name: go_back
function.description: Go back in browser history. Waits for page load to complete.

function.name: list_tabs
function.description: List open tabs in this workspace with their IDs, titles, and URLs.

function.name: right_click
function.description: Right-click on an element (dispatches contextmenu event). Auto-scrolls to element. If no menu appears, the page may not handle contextmenu events.

function.name: set_checkbox
function.description: Set a checkbox or radio to checked/unchecked. Fires input and change events.

checked.description: Whether the input should be checked.

function.name: click_coordinates
function.description: Click at viewport X/Y coordinates. ONLY use when the target has no [N] tag (canvas apps, games, obfuscated UIs). Prefer click_element when a tag exists.

description.description: What you expect to click (for logging).

function.name: download_file
function.description: Start a download to the user's downloads folder. Returns immediately — download completes in the background.

url.description: URL of the file to download.

filename.description: Optional filename for the downloaded file.

function.name: get_cookies
function.description: Get cookies for a URL. Defaults to current tab.

url.description: URL to get cookies for. Omit for current tab.

function.name: set_cookie
function.description: Set a cookie for a URL.

function.name: delete_cookie
function.description: Delete a specific cookie by name and URL.

function.name: search_history
function.description: Search browser history by keyword.

function.name: inspect_hidden
function.description: Scan the page for hidden DOM elements (display:none, visibility:hidden, opacity:0, off-screen, color camouflage, aria-hidden, etc). Use when you suspect content is intentionally hidden in the page — hidden codes, invisible text, or CSS-concealed elements that don't appear in the normal page snapshot.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive text filter. Only return elements whose text contains this substring.

function.name: xray_page
function.description: Toggle X-ray mode: forces all hidden elements visible (overrides display:none, opacity:0, visibility:hidden). Call again to disable. Use when you suspect content is hidden by CSS.

function.name: recall_demo
function.description: Retrieve a saved demonstration by name or description. Returns step-by-step instructions from a previously recorded workflow. Use when you recognize a matching demo from the catalog, or when stuck on a repetitive task.

query.description: Demo name, goal, or description to search for.
